The archive's sha512 matched the registry's "dist.integrity" for leaflet@1.9.4 (downloaded 2026-10-30; downloaded and
compared again 2026-11-09, when the SHA-256 lines below were added — PLAN-0006 T5).
Copied from the archive: dist/leaflet.js, dist/leaflet.css, dist/images/*.png, LICENSE.
One change: leaflet.css and LICENSE were converted from CRLF to LF line endings (the project's eol gate);
their content is otherwise byte-for-byte the published files.
Kept in the site itself (ADR-0012, ADR-0013), so a visitor's browser asks no third party for it.
tests/test_vendor.py compares every file below with its SHA-256.
